title: GENSTRAT: Toward a Science of Strategic Reasoning in Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2605.23238v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Fixed game suites for evaluating strategic reasoning in large language models (LLMs) saturate and are hard to keep free of contamination. We introduce GENSTRAT, a system for evaluating the strategic capabilities of LLMs driven by procedural generation of two-player zero-sum imperfect-information betting games, allowing an evaluator to draw novel, fresh games on demand. Each game is characterized on a scale of five complexity axes (state space, temporal contingency, opponent dependence, private information, precision) and measured by Monte Carlo simulation. Using this generator, we construct a 50-game benchmark and hold a tournament of twelve frontier and open-weight models, gathering data from over 40,000 LLM vs. LLM matches. We further construct a composite complexity axis, and find that, on the eight hardest games, the gap between the best and worst model is 1.7x its value across the whole set of games. translated_title: GENSTRAT：迈向大语言模型策略推理科学
translated_abstract: 用于评估大语言模型（LLM）策略推理能力的固定游戏套件容易饱和，且难以避免数据污染。我们提出了GENSTRAT，一个通过程序化生成双人零和不完全信息下注博弈来评估LLM策略能力的系统，使评估者能够按需抽取新颖、全新的游戏。每个游戏在五个复杂性维度（状态空间、时间关联性、对手依赖性、私有信息、精确性）上进行特征刻画，并通过蒙特卡洛模拟进行测量。利用该生成器，我们构建了一个包含50个游戏的基准测试，并举办了十二个前沿模型和开放权重模型的锦标赛，收集了超过40,000场LLM对LLM比赛的数据。我们进一步构建了一个复合复杂性维度，发现在八个最困难的游戏上，最佳模型与最差模型之间的差距是其在全部游戏集合上差距的1.7倍。消融实验表明……（原文摘要不完整，此处为已提供部分的翻译）
tldr: 提出GENSTRAT系统，通过程序化生成双人零和不完全信息下注博弈按需创建全新评估游戏，解决了固定游戏套件饱和与数据污染问题，并通过50个游戏的基准和40,000多场模型对战的锦标赛揭示了不同LLM策略推理能力的显著差异。
